summary: Cuprina Holdings (Cayman) Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting outcomes of its October 15, 2026 Extraordinary General Meeting, held in Singapore and by webcast; the September 8, 2026 record date showed 920,644 Class A shares (one vote each) and 1,760,625 Class B shares (100 votes each). Shareholders approved increasing authorized share capital from US$100,000 (12,500,000 shares at US$0.008 par) to US$10,000,000 (1,250,000,000 shares), and adopted a Third Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles lowering the written-resolution threshold to a simple majority. An adjournment proposal also passed. This is a routine EGM result, equivalent to a US annual/special meeting vote, not a special situation.
